note: Hand-checked corrections of the Greynir parse, applied by scripts/build-tags.mjs: in the given sentence, the given word is the given course word. A fixed sentence keeps no parser cases in data/tags.json, because they come from the wrong parse.

fixes.reason: Ég sé það (I can see that): the parser reads sé as the subjunctive of vera.
Ég sé það ekki (I don't see it): the parser reads sé as the subjunctive of vera.
Sá einhver hvað gerðist? (did anybody see what happened?): the parser reads Sá as the pronoun sá.
Eru þeir bræður? (are they brothers?): þeir is the personal pronoun they, not the demonstrative sá.
Hvaða tungumál tala þau í Kóreu? (what languages do they speak in Korea?): þau is the personal pronoun they, not the demonstrative sá.
